artifacts.summary: Per-file findings for all 7 hard-mode test/lint files: where each mechanism now lives inside skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md's hard_mode branches, what survives a mechanical retarget vs. what needs a logic rewrite, and a semantic-drift fix required in the loop-guard-budget-override test's Case 4.

next_steps: Run /plan 120 to create an implementation plan from this report.

memory_candidates.content: When a source-store consolidation merges two sibling SKILL.md files (e.g. a base engine + its -hard variant) into one file with hard_mode-gated branches, tests that previously compared the two files for parity (extract-and-diff pattern) lose their comparison target and need a structural rewrite (extract-once, assert-correctness) rather than a path-only retarget. Tests anchored on sentinel comments (# --- name:begin/:end ---) that already existed identically in both source files typically retarget mechanically since the merge keeps one copy under the same sentinel name; tests anchored on field-level jq-filter extraction are more likely to hit variable-name/read-form drift where the merge consolidated or renamed the field read.
